site.name: Gale Mine
site.location: Boulder County Tungsten Mining District near Nederland
overview: The Gale Mine is a documented tungsten property in Boulder County's historic tungsten district near Nederland.
Federal mineral-exploration records identify the Gale Mine as DMEA docket 3483 and place the property in Section 7, Township 1 South, Range 72 West.

timeline.text: Federal Defense Minerals Exploration Administration records list Harold and Tommy Williams with the Gale Mine tungsten project under docket 3483; the project was terminated.

moreHistory: Colorado Geological Survey mapping retained in the Remnant registry places Gale workings in the northwest quarter of Section 7, Township 1 South, Range 72 West and documents a shaft associated with the property. The location shown here is a historic mine-level reference point rather than a claim of a modern surveyed shaft collar.
U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 1004 preserves the federal exploration record for the Gale Mine and identifies tungsten as the target commodity.
